note: The target carrier's rail travel (Adopt :72-118, including the box-centre-not-group-origin station-finding gotcha and the two-range-units-in-one-world firingZ/endZ-in-parent-frame handling), the paper's damped-pendulum sway under the carrier's own acceleration + air drag + flutter (Sway :229-261), a round's leverage-weighted push on the pendulum (Hit :269-291, using Transform.IsChildOf instead of the JS's manual ancestor walk), and the F/G drive state machine incl. tap-vs-hold and the end-stop clunk (Update :342-411). TWO REAL BUGS CAUGHT DURING REVIEW (both now fixed, not silently introduced): Unity's RailMotorVoice needs an explicit Tick(dt) to drive its wind-down (the JS's WebAudio automation has no Unity equivalent — that class's own header says so; an earlier draft here just dropped the reference and never called Stop()/Tick()); and Mathf.Sign(0)==+1 in Unity vs. Math.sign(0)===0 in JS, which would have stopped the carrier drifting with dir=1 forever at an exact arrival instead of settling to 0 (rangelane.js:380's `|| 0` is NOT a no-op in Unity the way it is in JS).
